name: broderick
status: SEED v0 — extrapolated from source panels 2026-06-11; refine before render
look: Hand-drawn digital memoir comic in black-and-white sketch ink — scratchy, energetic pen linework with dense scribbled hatching on hair and clothing, left rough and unpolished. White paper grounds; background figures and clutter fade to pale ghost-gray line while the subject stays full black. Solid black silhouettes used as menace (the looming teacher) and as graphic device (evolution title card, the strip's lone blue accent). Hand-lettered all-caps caption strips run along the top as adult narration; black END card closes.
register: absurdist deadpan comedy register; the joke is in the timing and the flatness of the delivery

ink_black.usage: primary linework, silhouettes (teacher, evolution figures), striped shirt bands, END card

paper_white.usage: untouched page ground in every panel; negative space does the staging

ghost_gray.usage: faded background linework — classmate, classroom clutter, alphabet wall strip; depth via line fade not tone

mid_gray.usage: sparse flat fills: globe, sweater stripes, shadow accents

title_blue.usage: single color accent — the AUTOBIOGRAPHY title-card lettering with drop shadow; appears nowhere else

casting_canon.young_broderick: Boy, about 6, slight build, shaggy mop of hair over his forehead, freckles, striped short-sleeve shirt, at a one-piece school desk; absorbed and content drawing, then hollow-eyed shock.
casting_canon.teacher: Elderly schoolteacher, stout, severe tight hair bun, cat-eye glasses over heavy-lidded contemptuous eyes, deep frown lines, jowls, small drop earrings, dark striped sweater, wooden pointer stick; first seen as a looming solid-black silhouette; cold droning authoritarian.
casting_canon.classmate: Skinny boy, about 6, short hair, large wide eyes, gawky posture, at a background desk; alarmed wincing bystander rendered in faded ghost-gray line.

negatives: photorealistic, photograph, 3d render, cgi, cinematic lighting, lens flare, gradient shading, airbrush, watermark, signature, garbled text, malformed lettering, extra fingers, color except title-card blue, clean smooth vector linework, polished even line weight, full-tone backgrounds, gray wash fills on background figures, screentone, crosshatch density on the paper-white ground

continuity.comics: Lock each recurring character with a model sheet (front/side/expression strip) before generating strips; restate the full character description in every panel prompt.
continuity.video: Use the locked panel art as the first frame; restate the full character description in every shot.

legal_rule: Specify every character by age, origin, build, wardrobe, and affect only — never by likeness to a real public figure. If a render resembles a real person, regenerate.

failure_fixes.drifts_photoreal: Add: rough hand-drawn pen sketch comic, scratchy ink line, white paper background, no photographic rendering, no 3d.
failure_fixes.drifts_polished: Add: loose scribbled hatching, unpolished sketch energy, visible rough strokes.
failure_fixes.lettering_garbled: Generate art without text; add hand-lettering in post or via dedicated lettering pass.
